format.description: quote by default; disagreement only for a real disagreement; no_quote only when there are no timestamped turns

quote.description: Verbatim contiguous span of one turn, 8-30 words, no surrounding quotation marks; empty unless format is quote

source_speaker.description: Label of the quoted turn without brackets, e.g. C; empty unless format is quote

source_timestamp.description: MM:SS (or H:MM:SS) printed on the quoted turn; empty unless format is quote

source_person.description: Full name of whoever said the quote; empty unless format is quote

context.description: One context sentence for quote; the whole post text for disagreement and no_quote. No URL, hashtags or @-mentions

theme_hashtag.description: At most one theme hashtag including the #, never #DevSecOps; empty string for none

speaker_map.description: Every speaker label you could place, with the person's full name
